metric: Existing independently checked E1 author scoring; DocVQA ANLS, TextVQA consensus, deterministic local AI2D exact; author XLSX/pandas roundtrip preserved
scope: Exploratory complete DEV only; per-image paired; no CONFIRM or FINAL prediction or decoded answer
gate: Full 384-question/1536-prediction panel, genuine container/worker/verifier/reviewer exit and both independent acceptance proofs before opening predictions or decoding truth
missing_outputs: Empty and truncated answers remain in the denominator and are counted separately
multiplicity: Four contrasts and task-level intervals are exploratory and are not corrected for multiple comparisons
cost: No speed or memory claim from identity/quality panel
